mode.title: Permission mode
mode.description: Pins the agent's permission mode for every browser instance this policy reaches. One of manual, auto, or skip. Omit to leave the mode locally changeable.

requireProtectedConfirm.title: Require confirmation for protected actions
requireProtectedConfirm.description: Reserved: protected actions (credentials, payment details, file writes/downloads, permission grants) always require an explicit decision regardless of this value — it cannot be used to remove that requirement.

sites.title: Remembered site decisions
sites.description: Administrator-placed per-site allow/deny entries. Each entry is scoped to one origin and one non-protected action class.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: The exact origin this entry applies to, e.g. https://example.com.
